purpose: Record what was actually inspected when attempting a source-grounded FUNUJE UX/UI/brand interface pull, and what was found absent.
note: This is a non-runtime evidence record. It is not validated by scripts/validate-control-plane.mjs, which only reads work_orders/WRASAL-####.json. It establishes no project facts and no canonical acceptance.

inspections.source: node script implementing WCAG 2.x relative luminance and contrast ratio over the eight declared hex values
inspections.observed_result: 18 pairings computed. Material findings: warm-cream #F4E6C8 on signal-red #E31B23 = 3.82:1, which FAILS WCAG AA for body text (4.5:1 required) - this is the work order's declared primary CTA. White on signal-red = 4.72:1 (passes AA). signal-red as text on obsidian #050505 = 4.32:1 (large text only). graphite-glass #171717 on obsidian #050505 = 1.14:1 (panel invisible by fill alone; requires stroke). deep-wine #5A0B12 on obsidian = 1.45:1 (surface-only color). cyan-signal #28D7E8 on obsidian = 11.62:1 (highest-contrast accent available).

leading_hypothesis.statement: The connected Google account is probably not the one holding the FUNUJE material.
leading_hypothesis.basis: The connected Drive holds 44 files owned across myfavouritejamaican@gmail.com, caostherebel@gmail.com and wrayrasal@gmail.com, dominated by 2024 'My Favorite Jamaican' business planning. The Linear workspace, by contrast, holds current and active WRASAL portfolio work under wrayveart@gmail.com. The identity mismatch suggests FUNUJE assets live in a Drive account that is not currently connected.
leading_hypothesis.label: INFERRED
leading_hypothesis.cheapest_test: Connect the Google account that holds the FUNUJE Drive folder and re-run Phase 1.

authority_envelope_compliance.note: No external design reference was consulted. All non-observed material is labeled DECLARED (work-order-stated), INFERRED, or UNRESOLVED. Nothing is labeled VERIFIED except facts directly observed through tool inspection and the contrast computation.
